$comment: Shared partial-call fixture, consumed by BOTH ports: android PileupPartialCallTest and ios MorseKitCheck. Data, not code — see CLAUDE.md's two-ports rule.

derivation.fragment: upper-case the typed text, then drop every space and every '?'
derivation.tight: the fragment is a run of consecutive characters of the call
derivation.loose: the fragment's characters occur in the call in that order, with anything at all between them; every tight partial is also loose
derivation.engine: a non-empty fragment is tried as a tight partial, then as a near miss, then as a loose partial; an empty fragment asks the whole pileup to call again (#85, #143)
derivation.note: Worked by hand from the rules above, independently of either port. Cases with tight/loose null pin only the fragment.
